title: She was with hundreds of men at the very end 🕯️
caption:
Every one of them said the same thing.
Send this to someone who works too hard 👇
sources: Ware B. (2011) 'The Top Five Regrets of the Dying' (Hay House); adapted from her 2009 blog post 'Regrets of the Dying' ('This came from every male patient that I nursed')
